title: Supervised Learning — The Covered Answer Key
key_insight: Supervised learning follows that pattern. Each training example has inputs and a known answer called a label.
body:
## The Covered Answer Key

A student sees many animal photos with the correct animal written underneath. Later, the labels are covered and the student names a new photo.

Supervised learning follows that pattern. Each training example has inputs and a known answer called a label.

The real goal is not remembering the practice cards. It is learning a pattern that still works when a new card arrives.
common_mistakes: Treating training accuracy as proof that new cases will work.
Using a classification score for a numeric prediction problem.
Assuming every recorded label is perfectly correct.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “The Covered Answer Key” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Most practical prediction systems begin with labeled historical examples.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “The Covered Answer Key” story, explain Supervised Learning without assuming the listener knows machine learning.
